title: My Year of Rest and Relaxation
author: Ottessa Moshfegh
summary: A young, wealthy and numb woman in New York in 2000 decides to sleep through a year with the help of prescriptions from a careless psychiatrist. She believes it will let her wake up renewed.
readIf: you like black comedy and unlikeable narrators, with a cool, deadpan view of privilege and numbness.
skipIf: you want sympathy or a plot, or you find heavy drug use and depression hard to read about.

pairings.reason: The older classic of a bright young woman in New York falling into depression.
A short, offbeat novel about a woman at odds with expectations, with more warmth.
Another isolated, sharp-tongued narrator, but with a hopeful and kinder arc.
